title: Eval-v2 Scenario
description: One context-need scenario for the composed-context coverage eval (Mission mis_01KRPF3DERZS2W5VFDYE9E9GKM). See schema.md for the field reference + diversity floor.

scenario_id.description: Stable kebab-case slug (3-64 chars). Used as the raw-result filename.

trigger.description: Free-text session-start context. Human-readable; not parsed.

tools_invoked.description: Ordered MCP tool names the runner will invoke for this scenario.

expected_entities.description: PI-ratified ground-truth set. Min 5 total; min 3 with importance='critical' (enforced by the validator separately).

entity_id.description: Full RKA entity ID with prefix.

context_length_budget_estimate.description: Informational token budget; eval does not enforce.

notes.description: Brain's rationale or edge-case explanation. Not used by metrics.

annotated_at.description: ISO date of the most recent per-scenario annotation review (v2.5.6+; mis_01KS0QEW21N2NG4EJTKJ3JTWTE corpus refresh). Tracks the freshness of expected_entities against the live RKA database state.
